text: join descendant text nodes in tree order, collapse HTML whitespace runs, trim outer HTML whitespace
itemref: whitespace-separated same-document element IDs; only itemscope node itemref is interpreted
walk: starting descendants plus referenced nodes, visit DOM node once per item; nested itemscope creates entity boundary and must not traverse inside as outer properties
anonymous_identity: document_id plus stable source DOM path; no graph canonicalization
IRI: resolve against first usable base href then source page URL
bad_references: preserve known properties, entity incomplete and structured diagnostic
